We also examined the effects of 3 additional SNP loci, rs11063069 near CCND2 and rs8108269 near GIPR, which were identified in sex-differentiated analyses [16], and rs8090011 in LAMA1, which was shown to be associated with non-obese type 2 diabetes in European GWAS [15], but we did not replicate the original association in the Japanese population (Tables 4 and 5, S3 Table).
